name: PPMI-Benchmark
description: A dual evaluation framework and benchmark for imputation and synthetic data generation on longitudinal Parkinson's Disease (PPMI) data.
evaluation_method: RMSE (for imputation) and distributional metrics such as MMD / utility metrics for synthetic data
reputation: A domain-specific benchmark used in medical ML research on Parkinson's Disease data with limited but targeted adoption in the clinical ML community.
notes: Contains sensitive clinical longitudinal data (privacy concerns); evaluation uses both error-based and distributional/utility metrics; sample size and cohort-specific characteristics may limit generalizability; not oriented toward LLM evaluation.
